scope: Documentation of the audited installed protocol; no live data or execution settings

Control_AMR.scheduling_authority: Existing Scheduled automation; column B never decides when a job runs

Control_AMR_Run.purpose: Technical lease, fencing token and insertion cursor; preserve existing sheet

Vuelos.grain: One observed available cabin per query date, route and round-trip dates
Vuelos.award_taxes_mxn_definition: Exact Impuestos y Tasas (MXN) from points checkout; excludes carrier money component and is not checkout grand total
Vuelos.formulas: Preserve the formulas already owned by O:R; do not infer or replace their definitions
Vuelos.partial_results: One complete available cabin is valid; no blank row is allocated to an unavailable cabin

local_excel_policy: A dated export is a private read-only snapshot, never the queue or results authority
